import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.cluster import AgglomerativeClustering

MAX_DRIVERS = 5

def design(feats):
    # Identify strongly associated features
    effect_sizes = [abs(feats.x[:, feats.column(fid)].mean() * feats.y.mean()) 
                   for fid in feats.ids]
    strong_features = [fid for fid, effect in zip(feats.ids, effect_sizes) if effect > 0.1]
    
    # If no strong features, return empty design
    if not strong_features:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Cluster correlated features
    corr_matrix = np.corrcoef(feats.x[:, [feats.column(fid) for fid in strong_features]].T)
    clustering = AgglomerativeClustering(n_clusters=2, linkage='average')
    clusters = clustering.fit_predict(1 - np.abs(corr_matrix))
    
    # Select the larger cluster as our module
    module = [strong_features[i] for i in range(len(strong_features)) if clusters[i] == np.bincount(clusters).argmax()]
    
    # Compute weighted score using first principal component
    module_data = feats.x[:, [feats.column(fid) for fid in module]]
    _, _, vt = np.linalg.svd(module_data, full_matrices=False)
    weights = vt[0] / np.linalg.norm(vt[0])
    loadings = dict(zip(module, weights))
    
    # Return design with module members as drivers and loadings
    return Design(
        drivers=tuple(module),
        columns=tuple(module),
        products=(),
        loadings=loadings
    )
